program.help:
Full-group collision decomposition (the batch counterpart to the targeted lasso decollide). Builds a mean-waveform template per unit, then for every spike tries to explain it as a shifted, scaled sum of two templates (matching pursuit). Each accepted two-template fit is written to a .col sidecar (<base>.col.<method>.<group>[.<clu-tag>]); on success Klusters grows a decollided stage from the accepted records — each collision spike replaced by its two clean constituents in res/clu/spk and the in-memory .fet — and opens it.
Reads the clustering files ON DISK (save first if you have unsaved edits). session / method / group / n-samp / n-channels and the open stage's clu-tag are prefilled from the open group; clu-tag empty reads the untagged canonical clu. param-file is an optional session YAML for per-group nSamples/peak/channels (the n-samp prefill already covers the open group, so it is only needed for a peak-centred correlation window). Tuning: a fit passes when its best single-unit correlation clears corr-threshold, its two-template residual is below residual-threshold, and each component's amplitude clears min-snr-rms x the RMS noise; templates with fewer than min-spikes-template spikes are skipped and exclude-noise drops clusters 0/1 from the template set. Engine: the ndmanager-plugins 'process_decomposecollisions' console tool.
